name: Creature of the Void
summary: In Orgrimmar, Gan'rul Bloodeye sends a young warlock after the stolen Tablet of Verga. The rogue Burning Blade cultists took it to their cavern at Skull Rock, and its runes are needed to summon a voidwalker.

sections.title: A Precarious Art
sections.body: Gan'rul Bloodeye trains Horde warlocks in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. Thrall's new realm regards fel magic with deep wariness because of the orcish clans' dark history. Gan'rul says few true warlocks remain in the Horde, but their perilous skills are essential to its survival. To serve the Warchief, an initiate must learn more than the chaotic fire of an imp; they must command beings of pure shadow and endurance.

sections.title: The Stolen Tablet
sections.body: The runes needed to summon a voidwalker are inscribed on the Tablet of Verga. The Burning Blade, a fanatical shadow cult, stole the relic and hides in a cavern at Skull Rock, right beneath the Warchief's nose. Gan'rul sends you into the cultists' den to recover the tablet and strike a bloody blow against the renegades who stain the name of all practicing warlocks.

faq.answer: Gan'rul Bloodeye is a senior warlock trainer in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. He oversees young Horde warlocks, teaching them to harness dark powers and bind otherworldly minions without falling to corruption.

faq.q: What is the Tablet of Verga?
faq.answer: The Tablet of Verga bears the specialized summoning runes needed to call a voidwalker from the Nether. The Burning Blade stole it, and Gan'rul needs it to guide the initiate through the ritual.
Skull Rock is a shadowy cavern directly east of Orgrimmar, along Durotar's rugged bluffs. Burning Blade cultists hide there.

faq.q: Why does Gan'rul Bloodeye despise the Burning Blade?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade serves demonic masters and undermines Thrall's Horde. Gan'rul sees the cult as a nuisance to the Warchief and a reckless blight that brings suspicion and disrepute on all practicing warlocks.

faq.q: Why do warlocks need to summon a voidwalker?
faq.answer: Voidwalkers are beings of the Nether that can absorb tremendous punishment and protect their summoner. Learning to bind one is an essential step in a warlock's survival and summoning power.

faq.q: What happens after retrieving the tablet?
faq.answer: After Gan'rul receives the Tablet of Verga, he gives the initiate the needed runes and summons them to complete the ritual in 'The Binding'. There, the warlock must physically subdue the summoned voidwalker to master it.

angles.text: As a warlock, you face a fundamental rite of passage: moving beyond small imps to command a frontline shadow minion.
As a member of Thrall's Horde, you belong to a people wary of fel practitioners. Mentors like Gan'rul guide those who study the dark arts to use their power in service to the Warchief.
As an orc haunted by the Shadow Council's history, you can find a measure of vengeance in hunting the Burning Blade, whose members still embrace demonic ruin.
